condition: recombinant DyP-loaded WT T=1 shell expressed in E. coli
method:
X-ray crystallography; MOLE pore analysis; 
APBS electrostatic analysis
notes:
Five-fold minor pore adjacent to the major five-fold pore; MOLE bottleneck diameter 3.4 ± 0.8 Å. Electrostatics are pH-dependent: exterior and 
interior are strongly negative at pH 7, while the pore is overall slightly negative at pH 4.5.
